Appendix B Proof of Theorem 3.2

B.1 Proof of Monte Carlo Estimators

We begin with the proof of Lemma 3.2, which states that the Monte Carlo estimator of the SR matrix is unbiased.

Proof of Lemma 3.2.

Since S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)=O⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)​O​(𝜽k,ℬk)⊤S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})=O(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})O(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})^{\top}, by the definition of O⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)O(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k}) in Eqs.  (2.6) and (2.7), we have:

S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)=1Ns−1​∑i=1Ns(∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|−1Ns​∑j=1Ns∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,j)|)​(∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|−1Ns​∑j=1Ns∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,j)|)⊤=1Ns−1​(∑i=1Ns∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|⊤−1Ns​∑i=1Ns∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|​∑j=1Ns∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,j)|⊤)=1Ns​∑i=1Ns∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|⊤−1Ns​(Ns−1)​∑1≤i≠j≤Ns∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,j)|⊤.\begin{split}S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})&=\dfrac{1}{N_{s}-1}\sum_{i=1}^{N_{s}}\left(\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|-\dfrac{1}{N_{s}}\sum_{j=1}^{N_{s}}\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,j})\right|\right)\left(\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|-\dfrac{1}{N_{s}}\sum_{j=1}^{N_{s}}\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,j})\right|\right)^{\top}\\ &=\dfrac{1}{N_{s}-1}\left(\sum_{i=1}^{N_{s}}\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|^{\top}-\dfrac{1}{N_{s}}\sum_{i=1}^{N_{s}}\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|\sum_{j=1}^{N_{s}}\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,j})\right|^{\top}\right)\\ &=\dfrac{1}{N_{s}}\sum_{i=1}^{N_{s}}\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|^{\top}-\dfrac{1}{N_{s}(N_{s}-1)}\sum_{1\leq i\neq j\leq N_{s}}\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,j})\right|^{\top}.\end{split} (B.1)

By Assumption 3.2, for any 1≤i≤Ns1\leq i\leq N_{s} and i≠ji\neq j,

𝔼ℬk​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|⊤]=𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|⊤]𝔼ℬk​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,j)|⊤]=𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|]​𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|]⊤.\begin{split}\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{B}_{k}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|^{\top}\right]&=\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|^{\top}\right]\\ \mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{B}_{k}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,j})\right|^{\top}\right]&=\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]^{\top}.\end{split}

Therefore,

𝔼ℬk​[S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)]=𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|⊤]−𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|]​𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|]⊤=S⁡(𝜽k).\begin{split}\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{B}_{k}}\left[S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right]&=\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|^{\top}\right]-\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]^{\top}\\ &=S(\bm{\theta}_{k}).\end{split}

∎

Next, we estimate the error induced by Monte Carlo sampling. Before doing so, we prove an auxiliary counting lemma that will be used in the subsequent bounds.

Lemma B.1.

Let ℐ:={(i1,i2,j1,j2):1≤i1≠j1≤N,1≤i2≠j2≤N}\mathcal{I}:=\{(i_{1},i_{2},j_{1},j_{2}):1\leq i_{1}\neq j_{1}\leq N,~1\leq i_{2}\neq j_{2}\leq N\}. Then

♯⁡{(i1,i2,j1,j2)∈ℐ:i1=i2​ or ​j1=j2}=2​N​(N−1)2−N⁡(N−1),\sharp\{(i_{1},i_{2},j_{1},j_{2})\in\mathcal{I}:i_{1}=i_{2}\text{ or }j_{1}=j_{2}\}=2N(N-1)^{2}-N(N-1),

where ♯\sharp denotes the cardinality of a set.

Proof.

We count the tuples in ℐ\mathcal{I} satisfying i1=i2i_{1}=i_{2} or j1=j2j_{1}=j_{2} as following.

  1. (1)

    Count the case i1=i2i_{1}=i_{2}.

    Choose i:=i1=i2i:=i_{1}=i_{2} in NN ways. For each fixed ii, we must choose j1≠ij_{1}\neq i and j2≠ij_{2}\neq i, which can be done in (N−1)2(N-1)^{2} ways. Hence there are N​(N−1)2N(N-1)^{2} tuples with i1=i2i_{1}=i_{2}.

  2. (2)

    Count the case j1=j2j_{1}=j_{2}.

    By the same argument, there are N​(N−1)2N(N-1)^{2} tuples with j1=j2j_{1}=j_{2}.

  3. (3)

    Subtract the overlap.

    The overlap consists of tuples with both i1=i2i_{1}=i_{2} and j1=j2j_{1}=j_{2}. Choose i:=i1=i2i:=i_{1}=i_{2} in NN ways and then choose j:=j1=j2j:=j_{1}=j_{2} with j≠ij\neq i, in (N−1)(N-1) ways. Thus the overlap has size N⁡(N−1)N(N-1).

Combining the three steps gives

N​(N−1)2+N​(N−1)2−N⁡(N−1)=2​N​(N−1)2−N⁡(N−1),N(N-1)^{2}+N(N-1)^{2}-N(N-1)=2N(N-1)^{2}-N(N-1),

which completes the proof. ∎

Lemma B.2.

Under Assumptions 3.1 and 3.2, for any k≥0k\geq 0,

𝔼ℬk​[‖g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖2]≤24​CmNs,𝔼ℬk​[‖S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖F2]≤6​CmNs.\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{B}_{k}}\left[\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|^{2}\right]\leq\dfrac{24C_{m}}{N_{s}},\quad\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{B}_{k}}\left[\left\|S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|_{F}^{2}\right]\leq\dfrac{6C_{m}}{N_{s}}.
Proof.

We first bound the error of g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k}). By the definition of g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k}) in Eqs. (2.5) and (2.4), and similarly to Eq. (B.1), we have

g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)=2Ns​∑i=1NsEloc​(𝜽k,Xk,i)​∇𝜽​log⁡|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|−2Ns​(Ns−1)​∑1≤i≠j≤NsEloc​(𝜽k,Xk,i)​∇𝜽​log⁡|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,j)|.g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})=\dfrac{2}{N_{s}}\sum_{i=1}^{N_{s}}E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X_{k,i})\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|-\dfrac{2}{N_{s}(N_{s}-1)}\sum_{1\leq i\neq j\leq N_{s}}E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X_{k,i})\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,j})\right|.

Hence

g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)−g⁡(𝜽k)=2Ns​∑i=1Ns(Eloc​(𝜽k,Xk,i)​∇𝜽​log⁡|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|−𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[Eloc​(𝜽k,X)​∇𝜽​log⁡|ψ𝜽k​(X)|])−2Ns​(Ns−1)∑1≤i≠j≤Ns(Eloc(𝜽k;Xk,i)∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(Xk,j)|−𝔼X∼π𝜽k[Eloc(𝜽k;X)]𝔼X∼π𝜽k[∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|]).\begin{split}g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})&-g(\bm{\theta}_{k})=\dfrac{2}{N_{s}}\sum_{i=1}^{N_{s}}\left(E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X_{k,i})\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|-\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]\right)\\ &-\dfrac{2}{N_{s}(N_{s}-1)}\sum_{1\leq i\neq j\leq N_{s}}\left(E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X_{k,i})\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,j})\right|-\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\right]\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]\right).\end{split}

Using ‖a+b‖2≤2​‖a‖2+2​‖b‖2\left\|a+b\right\|^{2}\leq 2\left\|a\right\|^{2}+2\left\|b\right\|^{2}, we obtain

‖g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)−g⁡(𝜽k)‖2≤8Ns2​‖∑i=1Ns(Eloc​(𝜽k,Xk,i)​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,i)|−𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[Eloc​(𝜽k,X)​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|])‖2+8Ns2​(Ns−1)2​‖∑1≤i≠j≤Ns(Eloc​(𝜽k,Xk,i)​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(Xk,j)|−𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[Eloc​(𝜽k,X)]​𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|])‖2.\begin{split}&\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right\|^{2}\leq\dfrac{8}{N_{s}^{2}}\left\|\sum_{i=1}^{N_{s}}\left(E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X_{k,i})\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,i})\right|-\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]\right)\right\|^{2}\\ &+\dfrac{8}{N_{s}^{2}(N_{s}-1)^{2}}\left\|\sum_{1\leq i\neq j\leq N_{s}}\left(E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X_{k,i})\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X_{k,j})\right|-\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\right]\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]\right)\right\|^{2}.\end{split}

Taking expectation over ℬk\mathcal{B}_{k} and using Assumption 3.2, the cross terms involving different samples vanish. Therefore,

𝔼ℬk​[‖g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖2]≤8Ns​𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[‖Eloc​(𝜽k,X)​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|−𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[Eloc​(𝜽k,X)​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|]‖2]+8Ns2​(Ns−1)2∑i1≠j1​ and ​i2≠j2,i1=i2​ or ​j1=j2𝔼(X,X′)∼π𝜽k⊗2[‖Eloc(𝜽k;X)∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X′)|−𝔼X∼π𝜽k[Eloc(𝜽k;X)]𝔼X∼π𝜽k[∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|]‖2].\begin{split}&\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{B}_{k}}\left[\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|^{2}\right]\leq\dfrac{8}{N_{s}}\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\left\|E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|-\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]\right\|^{2}\right]\\ &+\dfrac{8}{N_{s}^{2}(N_{s}-1)^{2}}\sum_{\begin{subarray}{c}i_{1}\neq j_{1}\text{ and }i_{2}\neq j_{2},\\ i_{1}=i_{2}\text{ or }j_{1}=j_{2}\end{subarray}}\mathbb{E}_{(X,X^{\prime})\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}^{\otimes^{2}}}\left[\left\|E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X^{\prime})\right|-\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\right]\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]\right\|^{2}\right].\end{split}

Then, by Lemma B.1, the inequality 𝔼⁡[|Y−𝔼⁡[Y]|2]≤𝔼⁡[|Y|2]\mathbb{E}[\left|Y-\mathbb{E}[Y]\right|^{2}]\leq\mathbb{E}[\left|Y\right|^{2}], and the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we have

𝔼ℬk​[‖g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖2]≤8Ns𝔼X∼π𝜽k[‖Eloc(𝜽k;X)∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|‖2]+16Ns𝔼(X,X′)∼π𝜽k⊗2[‖Eloc(𝜽k;X)∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X′)|‖2]≤24Ns​𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[‖Eloc​(𝜽k,X)‖4]​𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[‖∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|‖4]≤24​CmNs.\begin{split}\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{B}_{k}}\left[\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|^{2}\right]&\leq\dfrac{8}{N_{s}}\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\left\|E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right\|^{2}\right]+\dfrac{16}{N_{s}}\mathbb{E}_{(X,X^{\prime})\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}^{\otimes^{2}}}\left[\left\|E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X^{\prime})\right|\right\|^{2}\right]\\ &\leq\dfrac{24}{N_{s}}\sqrt{\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\left\|E_{\text{loc}}(\bm{\theta}_{k};X)\right\|^{4}\right]\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\left\|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right\|^{4}\right]}\leq\dfrac{24C_{m}}{N_{s}}.\end{split}

The bound for S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k}) is similar:

𝔼ℬk​[‖S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖F2]≤2Ns​𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[‖∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|⊤−𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|​∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|⊤]‖F2]+4Ns𝔼(X,X′)∼π𝜽k⊗2[‖∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X′)|⊤−𝔼X∼π𝜽k[∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|]𝔼X∼π𝜽k[∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|⊤]‖F2]≤2Ns𝔼X∼π𝜽k[‖∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|⊤‖F2]+4Ns𝔼(X,X′)∼π𝜽k⊗2[‖∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X′)|⊤‖F2]=2Ns𝔼X∼π𝜽k[‖∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|‖F4]+4Ns𝔼(X,X′)∼π𝜽k⊗2[‖∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X)|‖2‖∇𝜽log|ψ𝜽k(X′)|‖2]≤2​CmNs+4Ns​(𝔼X∼π𝜽k​[‖∇𝜽​log​|ψ𝜽k​(X)|‖F4])2≤6​CmNs.\begin{split}&\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{B}_{k}}\left[\left\|S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|_{F}^{2}\right]\\ &\leq\dfrac{2}{N_{s}}\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\left\|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|^{\top}-\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|^{\top}\right]\right\|_{F}^{2}\right]\\ &+\dfrac{4}{N_{s}}\mathbb{E}_{(X,X^{\prime})\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}^{\otimes^{2}}}\left[\left\|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X^{\prime})\right|^{\top}-\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right]\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|^{\top}\right]\right\|_{F}^{2}\right]\\ &\leq\dfrac{2}{N_{s}}\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\left\|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|^{\top}\right\|_{F}^{2}\right]+\dfrac{4}{N_{s}}\mathbb{E}_{(X,X^{\prime})\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}^{\otimes^{2}}}\left[\left\|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X^{\prime})\right|^{\top}\right\|_{F}^{2}\right]\\ &=\dfrac{2}{N_{s}}\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\left\|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right\|_{F}^{4}\right]+\dfrac{4}{N_{s}}\mathbb{E}_{(X,X^{\prime})\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}^{\otimes^{2}}}\left[\left\|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right\|^{2}\left\|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X^{\prime})\right|\right\|^{2}\right]\\ &\leq\dfrac{2C_{m}}{N_{s}}+\dfrac{4}{N_{s}}\sqrt{\left(\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}}\left[\left\|\nabla_{\bm{\theta}}\log\left|\psi_{\bm{\theta}_{k}}(X)\right|\right\|_{F}^{4}\right]\right)^{2}}\leq\dfrac{6C_{m}}{N_{s}}.\end{split}

∎

Lemma B.3.

Under Assumptions 3.1 and 3.2, let {𝛉k,Δ​𝛉k}\{\bm{\theta}_{k},\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\} be generated by (SPRING), then for any 0≤μ<10\leq\mu<1, k≥0k\geq 0,

‖𝔼⁡[Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆|ℱk−1]‖2≤6​Cm​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2|ℱk−1]λ2​Ns,𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆‖2|ℱk−1]≤(1+2​μ2​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+2​Cmλ2)​12​Cmλ2​Ns,\begin{split}\left\|\mathbb{E}\left[\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]\right\|^{2}&\leq\dfrac{6C_{m}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]}{\lambda^{2}N_{s}},\\ \mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}\right\|^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]&\leq\left(1+2\mu^{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{2C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}}\right)\dfrac{12C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}N_{s}},\end{split}

where Δ​𝛉k⋆:=(λ​I+S⁡(𝛉k))−1​(λ​μ​Δ​𝛉k−1−12​g​(𝛉k))\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}:=\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right), and ℱk−1:=σ⁡({Xi,j}0≤i≤k−1,1≤j≤Ns)\mathscr{F}_{k-1}:=\sigma\left(\{X_{i,j}\}_{0\leq i\leq k-1,1\leq j\leq N_{s}}\right) is the σ\sigma-algebra generated by previous samples.

Proof.

We first prove the first inequality.

Δ​𝜽k\displaystyle\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k} −Δ​𝜽k⋆=(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))−1​(λ​μ​Δ​𝜽k−1−12​g​(𝜽k,ℬk))−(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))−1​(λ​μ​Δ​𝜽k−1−12​g​(𝜽k))\displaystyle-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}=\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)-\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)
=[(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))−1−(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))−1]​(λ​μ​Δ​𝜽k−1−12​g​(𝜽k,ℬk))+12​(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))−1​(g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))\displaystyle=\left[\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)^{-1}-\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\right]\left(\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)+\dfrac{1}{2}\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)
=(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))−1​(S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))​(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))−1​(λ​μ​Δ​𝜽k−1−12​g​(𝜽k,ℬk))\displaystyle=\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)
+12​(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))−1​(g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))\displaystyle\quad\quad+\dfrac{1}{2}\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)
=(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))−1​(S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))​Δ​𝜽k+12​(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))−1​(g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)).\displaystyle=\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}+\dfrac{1}{2}\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right).

By Assumption 3.2, taking the conditional expectation given ℱk−1\mathscr{F}_{k-1} yields

𝔼⁡[Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆|ℱk−1]=(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))−1​𝔼​[(S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))​Δ​𝜽k|ℱk−1].\mathbb{E}\left[\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]=\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right].

Then by the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality and Lemma B.2, we have

‖𝔼⁡[Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆|ℱk−1]‖≤1λ​𝔼​[‖S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖2⋅‖Δ​𝜽k‖|ℱk−1]≤1λ​𝔼⁡[‖S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖22|ℱk−1]​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2|ℱk−1]≤1λ​𝔼⁡[‖S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖F2|ℱk−1]​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2|ℱk−1]≤1λ​6​CmNs​𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2|ℱk−1].\begin{split}\left\|\mathbb{E}\left[\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]\right\|&\leq\dfrac{1}{\lambda}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|_{2}\cdot\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\||\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]\\ &\leq\dfrac{1}{\lambda}\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|_{2}^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]}\\ &\leq\dfrac{1}{\lambda}\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|_{F}^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]}\\ &\leq\dfrac{1}{\lambda}\sqrt{\dfrac{6C_{m}}{N_{s}}}\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]}.\end{split}

Next, we prove the second inequality. On the other hand, we can rewrite Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star} as

Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆=(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))−1​(S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))​(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))−1​(λ​μ​Δ​𝜽k−1−12​g​(𝜽k))+12​(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))−1​(g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)).\begin{split}\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}&=\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right)\\ &\quad\quad+\dfrac{1}{2}\left(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right)^{-1}\left(g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right).\end{split}

Since S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)⪰0S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\succeq 0 a.s., we have ‖(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))−1‖2≤1λ\left\|(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k}))^{-1}\right\|_{2}\leq\frac{1}{\lambda} a.s. Therefore, almost surely,

‖Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆‖≤1λ2​‖S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖F⋅‖λ​μ​Δ​𝜽k−1−12​g​(𝜽k)‖+12​λ​‖g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖⟹‖Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆‖2≤2λ4​‖S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖F2⋅‖λ​μ​Δ​𝜽k−1−12​g​(𝜽k)‖2+12​λ2​‖g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖2.\begin{split}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}\right\|&\leq\dfrac{1}{\lambda^{2}}\left\|S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|_{F}\cdot\left\|\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right\|+\dfrac{1}{2\lambda}\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|\\ \Longrightarrow\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}\right\|^{2}&\leq\dfrac{2}{\lambda^{4}}\left\|S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|_{F}^{2}\cdot\left\|\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{1}{2\lambda^{2}}\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|^{2}.\end{split}

Taking the conditional expectation given ℱk−1\mathscr{F}_{k-1} and using Lemmas A.1 and B.2 yields

𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆‖2|ℱk−1]≤2​‖λ​μ​Δ​𝜽k−1−12​g​(𝜽k)‖2λ4​𝔼​[‖S⁡(𝜽k)−S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖F2|ℱk−1]+12​λ2​𝔼​[‖g⁡(𝜽k)−g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖2|ℱk−1]≤12​Cmλ4​Ns​(2​λ2​μ2​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+12​‖g⁡(𝜽k)‖2)+12​Cmλ2​Ns≤12​Cmλ4​Ns​(2​λ2​μ2​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+2​Cm)+12​Cmλ2​Ns=(1+2​μ2​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+2​Cmλ2)​12​Cmλ2​Ns.\begin{split}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}\right\|^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]&\leq\dfrac{2\left\|\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right\|^{2}}{\lambda^{4}}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|S(\bm{\theta}_{k})-S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|_{F}^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]\\ &\qquad+\dfrac{1}{2\lambda^{2}}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}\right]\\ &\leq\dfrac{12C_{m}}{\lambda^{4}N_{s}}\left(2\lambda^{2}\mu^{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{1}{2}\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right\|^{2}\right)+\dfrac{12C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}N_{s}}\\ &\leq\dfrac{12C_{m}}{\lambda^{4}N_{s}}\left(2\lambda^{2}\mu^{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+2C_{m}\right)+\dfrac{12C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}N_{s}}\\ &=\left(1+2\mu^{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{2C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}}\right)\dfrac{12C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}N_{s}}.\end{split}

B.2 Estimation of Δ​θk\Delta\theta_{k}

Lemma B.4.

Under Assumptions 3.1 and 3.2, let {𝛉k,Δ​𝛉k}\{\bm{\theta}_{k},\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\} be generated from (SPRING), for any 0≤μ<10\leq\mu<1, k≥0k\geq 0, we have:

𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2]≤𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽0‖2]+4​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)2+24​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)2⋅1Ns,\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}]\leq\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{0}\right\|^{2}]+\dfrac{4(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})^{2}}+\dfrac{24(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})^{2}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{N_{s}},

where 𝔼⁡[⋅]\mathbb{E}[\cdot] is the total expectation.

Proof.

By Δ​𝜽k=(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k,ℬk))−1​(λ​μ​Δ​𝜽k−1−12​g​(𝜽k,ℬk))\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}=(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k}))^{-1}(\lambda\mu\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})) and Young inequality, almost surely,

‖Δ​𝜽k‖2≤(μ⁡‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖+12​λ​‖g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖)2≤μ2+12​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+1+μ24​λ2​(1−μ2)​‖g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)‖2≤μ2+12​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+1+μ22​λ2​(1−μ2)​‖g⁡(𝜽k,ℬk)−g⁡(𝜽k)‖2+1+μ22​λ2​(1−μ2)​‖g⁡(𝜽k)‖2.\begin{split}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}&\leq\left(\mu\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|+\dfrac{1}{2\lambda}\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|\right)^{2}\\ &\leq\dfrac{\mu^{2}+1}{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{1+\mu^{2}}{4\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})\right\|^{2}\\ &\leq\dfrac{\mu^{2}+1}{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{1+\mu^{2}}{2\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k};\mathcal{B}_{k})-g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{1+\mu^{2}}{2\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\left\|g(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right\|^{2}.\end{split}

Taking the conditional expectation given ℱk−1\mathscr{F}_{k-1} and using Lemmas A.1 and B.2 yields

𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2|ℱk−1]≤μ2+12​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+12​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)⋅1Ns+2​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2).\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}]\leq\dfrac{\mu^{2}+1}{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{12(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\cdot\dfrac{1}{N_{s}}+\dfrac{2(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}.

Taking total expectation, we obtain

𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2]≤μ2+12​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2]+12​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)⋅1Ns+2​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)=𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽0‖2]+(12​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)⋅1Ns+2​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2))​(1+1+μ22+⋯+(1+μ22)k−1)≤𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽0‖2]+(12​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)⋅1Ns+2​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2))​∑i=0∞(1+μ22)i=𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽0‖2]+4​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)2+24​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)2⋅1Ns.\begin{split}\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}]&\leq\dfrac{\mu^{2}+1}{2}\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}]+\dfrac{12(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\cdot\dfrac{1}{N_{s}}+\dfrac{2(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\\ &=\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{0}\right\|^{2}]+\left(\dfrac{12(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\cdot\dfrac{1}{N_{s}}+\dfrac{2(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\right)\left(1+\dfrac{1+\mu^{2}}{2}+\cdots+\left(\dfrac{1+\mu^{2}}{2}\right)^{k-1}\right)\\ &\leq\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{0}\right\|^{2}]+\left(\dfrac{12(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\cdot\dfrac{1}{N_{s}}+\dfrac{2(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})}\right)\sum_{i=0}^{\infty}\left(\dfrac{1+\mu^{2}}{2}\right)^{i}\\ &=\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{0}\right\|^{2}]+\dfrac{4(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})^{2}}+\dfrac{24(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})^{2}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{N_{s}}.\end{split}

Lemma B.5.

+2​ηk​Δ​𝜽k⊤​(λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k))​(Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆)+Cg2​ηk2​‖Δ​𝜽k‖2\displaystyle\qquad+2\eta_{k}\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\top}(\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k}))(\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star})+\dfrac{C_{g}}{2}\eta_{k}^{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}
(by ​ηk≤η0)\displaystyle(\text{by }\eta_{k}\leq\eta_{0})
≤λ​μ​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+(λ⁡(μ−2)+Cg2​η0)​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k‖2+2​ηk​‖λ​I+S⁡(𝜽k)‖2​‖Δ​𝜽k‖​‖Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆‖\displaystyle\leq\lambda\mu\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+(\lambda(\mu-2)+\dfrac{C_{g}}{2}\eta_{0})\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}+2\eta_{k}\left\|\lambda I+S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right\|_{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}\right\|
(by triangle inequality and Young inequality)\displaystyle(\text{by triangle inequality and Young inequality})
≤λ​μ​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+(λ⁡(μ−2)+Cg2​η0)​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k‖2+2​ηk​(λ+‖S⁡(𝜽k)‖F)​(ε​‖Δ​𝜽k‖2+14​ε​‖Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆‖2)\displaystyle\leq\lambda\mu\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+(\lambda(\mu-2)+\dfrac{C_{g}}{2}\eta_{0})\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}+2\eta_{k}(\lambda+\left\|S(\bm{\theta}_{k})\right\|_{F})\left(\varepsilon\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{1}{4\varepsilon}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}\right\|^{2}\right)
(by Lemma A.1 and let ​ε=2​λ​(1−μ)−Cg​η04​(λ+Cm))\displaystyle(\text{by \lx@cref{creftype~refnum}{lem:g_S_bounded} and let }\varepsilon=\dfrac{2\lambda(1-\mu)-C_{g}\eta_{0}}{4(\lambda+\sqrt{C_{m}})})
≤λ​μ​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2+(λ⁡(μ−2)+Cg2​η0)​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k‖2+(λ⁡(1−μ)−Cg2​η0)​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k‖2\displaystyle\leq\lambda\mu\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}+(\lambda(\mu-2)+\dfrac{C_{g}}{2}\eta_{0})\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}+(\lambda(1-\mu)-\dfrac{C_{g}}{2}\eta_{0})\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}
+2​(λ+Cm)22​λ​(1−μ)−Cg​η0​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆‖2\displaystyle\qquad+\dfrac{2(\lambda+\sqrt{C_{m}})^{2}}{2\lambda(1-\mu)-C_{g}\eta_{0}}\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}\right\|^{2}
=λ​μ​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2−λ​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k‖2+2​(λ+Cm)22​λ​(1−μ)−Cg​η0​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆‖2.\displaystyle=\lambda\mu\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}-\lambda\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}+\dfrac{2(\lambda+\sqrt{C_{m}})^{2}}{2\lambda(1-\mu)-C_{g}\eta_{0}}\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}\right\|^{2}.

Taking conditional expectation conditional on ℱk−1\mathscr{F}_{k-1}, and by Lemma B.3, we have

𝔼⁡[L⁡(𝜽k+1)|ℱk−1]−L⁡(𝜽k)≤λ​μ​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2−λ​ηk​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2|ℱk−1]+C~1​ηkNs+C~2​ηk​‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2Ns,\mathbb{E}[L(\bm{\theta}_{k+1})|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}]-L(\bm{\theta}_{k})\leq\lambda\mu\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}-\lambda\eta_{k}\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}|\mathscr{F}_{k-1}]+\tilde{C}_{1}\dfrac{\eta_{k}}{N_{s}}+\tilde{C}_{2}\dfrac{\eta_{k}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}}{N_{s}},

where C~1:=24​Cm​(λ+Cm)2λ2​(2​λ​(1−μ)−Cg​η0)​(1+2​Cmλ2)\tilde{C}_{1}:=\dfrac{24C_{m}(\lambda+\sqrt{C_{m}})^{2}}{\lambda^{2}(2\lambda(1-\mu)-C_{g}\eta_{0})}\left(1+\dfrac{2C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}}\right), and C~2:=48​Cm​μ2​(λ+Cm)2λ2​(2​λ​(1−μ)−Cg​η0)\tilde{C}_{2}:=\dfrac{48C_{m}\mu^{2}(\lambda+\sqrt{C_{m}})^{2}}{\lambda^{2}(2\lambda(1-\mu)-C_{g}\eta_{0})}.

Taking total expectation,

𝔼⁡[L⁡(𝜽k+1)]−𝔼⁡[L⁡(𝜽k)]\displaystyle\mathbb{E}[L(\bm{\theta}_{k+1})]-\mathbb{E}[L(\bm{\theta}_{k})] ≤λ​μ​ηk​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2]−λ​ηk​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2]+C~2​ηk​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2]Ns+C~1​ηkNs\displaystyle\leq\lambda\mu\eta_{k}\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}]-\lambda\eta_{k}\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}]+\tilde{C}_{2}\dfrac{\eta_{k}\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}]}{N_{s}}+\tilde{C}_{1}\dfrac{\eta_{k}}{N_{s}}
(for the third term, by Lemma B.4)\displaystyle(\text{for the third term, by \lx@cref{creftype~refnum}{lem:expect_delta_theta_bound}})
≤λ​μ​ηk​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2]−λ​ηk​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k‖2]+C1​ηkNs+C2​ηkNs2,\displaystyle\leq\lambda\mu\eta_{k}\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}]-\lambda\eta_{k}\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}]+C_{1}\dfrac{\eta_{k}}{N_{s}}+C_{2}\dfrac{\eta_{k}}{N_{s}^{2}},

where C1:=C~1+(𝔼⁡[‖Δ​𝜽0‖2]+4​(1+μ2)​Cmλ2​(1−μ2)2)​C~2C_{1}:=\tilde{C}_{1}+\left(\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{0}\right\|^{2}]+\dfrac{4(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})^{2}}\right)\tilde{C}_{2}, and C2:=24​(1+μ2)​Cm​C~2λ2​(1−μ2)2C_{2}:=\dfrac{24(1+\mu^{2})C_{m}\tilde{C}_{2}}{\lambda^{2}(1-\mu^{2})^{2}}.

Define the discrete energy Fk:=𝔼⁡[L⁡(𝜽k)]+λ​μ​ηk​𝔼​[‖Δ​𝜽k−1‖2]F_{k}:=\mathbb{E}[L(\bm{\theta}_{k})]+\lambda\mu\eta_{k}\mathbb{E}[\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}], and then again by ηk+1≤ηk\eta_{k+1}\leq\eta_{k}, we have

B.3 Proof of Theorem 3.2

Now, we are ready to prove Theorem 3.2.

Proof of Theorem 3.2.

By Lemma 3.1, we have:

L⁡(𝜽k+1)−L⁡(𝜽k)\displaystyle L(\bm{\theta}_{k+1})-L(\bm{\theta}_{k}) ≤ηk​g​(𝜽k)⊤​Δ​𝜽k+Cg2​ηk2​‖Δ​𝜽k‖2\displaystyle\leq\eta_{k}g(\bm{\theta}_{k})^{\top}\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}+\dfrac{C_{g}}{2}\eta_{k}^{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}
=ηk​g​(𝜽k)⊤​Δ​𝜽k⋆+ηk​g​(𝜽k)⊤​(Δ​𝜽k−Δ​𝜽k⋆)+Cg2​ηk2​‖Δ​𝜽k‖2.\displaystyle=\eta_{k}g(\bm{\theta}_{k})^{\top}\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star}+\eta_{k}g(\bm{\theta}_{k})^{\top}(\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}-\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}^{\star})+\dfrac{C_{g}}{2}\eta_{k}^{2}\left\|\Delta\bm{\theta}_{k}\right\|^{2}.

Appendix C Proof of Theorem 3.4

Proof.

According to the proof of Theorem 3.1 in Appendix A, it suffices to show that the gradient g⁡(𝜽)g(\bm{\theta}) is uniformly bounded and Lipschitz continuous. It is therefore enough to prove that both g⁡(𝜽)g(\bm{\theta}) and ∇2L​(𝜽)\nabla^{2}L(\bm{\theta}) are uniformly bounded.

Continuous Gaussian example. Since a constant does not change the function value, we consider the normalized wavefunction

ψθ​(x)=CΣ​e−14​(x−A​θ)⊤​Σ−1​(x−A​θ),𝐱=(𝒙1,…,𝒙N),𝒙i∈ℝ3,\psi_{\theta}(x)=C_{\Sigma}e^{-\frac{1}{4}(x-A\theta)^{\top}\Sigma^{-1}(x-A\theta)},\qquad\mathbf{x}=(\bm{x}_{1},\dots,\bm{x}_{N}),\quad\bm{x}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3},

whereA∈ℝ3​N×NpA\in\mathbb{R}^{3N\times N_{p}},Σ∈ℝ3​N×3​N\Sigma\in\mathbb{R}^{3N\times 3N} is symmetric positive definite and CΣ=(2π)−3N/4det(Σ)−1/4C_{\Sigma}=(2\pi)^{-3N/4}\det(\Sigma)^{-1/4}. Then π𝜽​(𝐱)=|ψ𝜽​(𝐱)|2\pi_{\bm{\theta}}(\mathbf{x})=|\psi_{\bm{\theta}}(\mathbf{x})|^{2} is the density of the Gaussian distribution X∼N⁡(A​𝜽,Σ)X\sim N(A\bm{\theta},\Sigma).

The electronic Hamiltonian is

ℋ=−12∑i=1NΔ𝒙i−∑i=1N∑I=1MZI‖𝒙i−𝑹I‖+∑1≤i<j≤N1‖𝒙i−𝒙j‖+Cnuc,Cnuc:=∑1≤I<I′≤MZI​ZI′‖𝑹I−𝑹I′‖.\mathscr{H}=-\frac{1}{2}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\Delta_{\bm{x}_{i}}-\sum_{i=1}^{N}\sum_{I=1}^{M}\frac{Z_{I}}{\|\bm{x}_{i}-\bm{R}_{I}\|}+\sum_{1\leq i<j\leq N}\frac{1}{\|\bm{x}_{i}-\bm{x}_{j}\|}+C_{\rm nuc},\quad C_{\rm nuc}:=\sum_{1\leq I<I^{\prime}\leq M}\frac{Z_{I}Z_{I^{\prime}}}{\|\bm{R}_{I}-\bm{R}_{I^{\prime}}\|}.

Hence L⁡(𝜽)=⟨ψ𝜽|ℋ|ψ𝜽⟩L(\bm{\theta})=\braket{\psi_{\bm{\theta}}|\mathscr{H}|\psi_{\bm{\theta}}} can be decomposed into a kinetic part and a potential part. For the kinetic term, using integration by parts

−12∑i=1N⟨ψ𝜽|Δ𝒙i|ψ𝜽⟩=12∫ℝ3​N‖∇𝐱ψ𝜽(𝐱)‖2d𝐱=18𝔼X∼π𝜽[(X−A𝜽)⊤Σ−2(X−A𝜽)]=18tr(Σ−1),-\dfrac{1}{2}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\braket{\psi_{\bm{\theta}}|\Delta_{\bm{x}_{i}}|\psi_{\bm{\theta}}}=\dfrac{1}{2}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{3N}}\left\|\nabla_{\mathbf{x}}\psi_{\bm{\theta}}(\mathbf{x})\right\|^{2}\mathrm{\,d}\mathbf{x}=\dfrac{1}{8}\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}}}\left[(X-A\bm{\theta})^{\top}\Sigma^{-2}(X-A\bm{\theta})\right]=\dfrac{1}{8}\text{tr}(\Sigma^{-1}),

where the last equality is from the the standard identity for centered Gaussian quadratic forms: if Y∼N⁡(0,Σ)Y\sim N(0,\Sigma), then for any matrix MM, 𝔼⁡[Y⊤​M​Y]=tr​(M​Σ)\mathbb{E}[Y^{\top}MY]=\text{tr}(M\Sigma).

For the potential terms, we first rewrite AA and Σ\Sigma in block forms:

A=(A1AN),Σ=(Σ11⋯Σ1​N⋱ΣN​1⋯ΣN​N),Ai∈ℝ3×Np,Σi​j∈ℝ3×3.A=\begin{pmatrix}A_{1}\\ \vdots\\ A_{N}\end{pmatrix},\quad\Sigma=\begin{pmatrix}\Sigma_{11}&\cdots&\Sigma_{1N}\\ \vdots&\ddots&\vdots\\ \Sigma_{N1}&\cdots&\Sigma_{NN}\end{pmatrix},\quad A_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times N_{p}},~\Sigma_{ij}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times 3}.

Then the random variable of each electronic coordination Xi∼N⁡(Ai​𝜽,Σi​i)X_{i}\sim N(A_{i}\bm{\theta},\Sigma_{ii}), and therefore

𝔼X∼π𝜽​[1‖Xi−𝑹I‖]=1(2​π)3/2​(detΣi​i)1/2​∫ℝ31‖𝒚‖​e−12​(𝒚−(Ai​𝜽−𝑹I))⊤​Σi​i−1​(𝒚−(Ai​𝜽−𝑹I))​𝑑𝒚.\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}}}\!\left[\frac{1}{\|X_{i}-\bm{R}_{I}\|}\right]=\frac{1}{(2\pi)^{3/2}(\det\Sigma_{ii})^{1/2}}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{3}}\frac{1}{\|\bm{y}\|}e^{-\frac{1}{2}(\bm{y}-(A_{i}\bm{\theta}-\bm{R}_{I}))^{\top}\Sigma_{ii}^{-1}(\bm{y}-(A_{i}\bm{\theta}-\bm{R}_{I}))}\mathrm{\,d}\bm{y}.

For the electron-electron term, define Yi​j:=Xi−XjY_{ij}:=X_{i}-X_{j}, and Yi​jY_{ij} is again Gaussian with the mean and covariance

𝔼⁡[Yi​j]=(Ai−Aj)​𝜽,Cov⁡(Yi​j)=Σi​i+Σj​j−Σi​j−Σj​i=:Γi​j.\mathbb{E}[Y_{ij}]=(A_{i}-A_{j})\bm{\theta},\quad\operatorname{Cov}(Y_{ij})=\Sigma_{ii}+\Sigma_{jj}-\Sigma_{ij}-\Sigma_{ji}=:\Gamma_{ij}.

Therefore, we have

𝔼X∼π𝜽​[1‖Xi−Xj‖]=𝔼⁡[1‖Yi​j‖]=1(2​π)3/2​(detΓi​j)1/2​∫ℝ31‖𝒚‖​e−12​(𝒚−(Ai−Aj)​𝜽)⊤​Γi​j−1​(𝒚−(Ai−Aj)​𝜽)​𝑑𝒚.\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}}}\!\left[\frac{1}{\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|}\right]=\mathbb{E}\!\left[\frac{1}{\|Y_{ij}\|}\right]=\frac{1}{(2\pi)^{3/2}(\det\Gamma_{ij})^{1/2}}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{3}}\frac{1}{\|\bm{y}\|}e^{-\frac{1}{2}(\bm{y}-(A_{i}-A_{j})\bm{\theta})^{\top}\Gamma_{ij}^{-1}(\bm{y}-(A_{i}-A_{j})\bm{\theta})}\mathrm{\,d}\bm{y}.

For any symmetric positive definite 3×33\times 3 matrix Γ\Gamma, define

UΓ​(𝒛):=1(2​π)3/2​(detΓ)1/2​∫ℝ31‖𝒚‖​e−12​(𝒚−𝒛)⊤​Γ−1​(𝒚−𝒛)​𝑑𝒚.U_{\Gamma}(\bm{z}):=\frac{1}{(2\pi)^{3/2}(\det\Gamma)^{1/2}}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{3}}\frac{1}{\|\bm{y}\|}e^{-\frac{1}{2}(\bm{y}-\bm{z})^{\top}\Gamma^{-1}(\bm{y}-\bm{z})}\mathrm{\,d}\bm{y}.

Then the above two identities become

𝔼X∼π𝜽​[1‖Xi−𝑹I‖]=UΣi​i​(Ai​𝜽−𝑹I),𝔼X∼π𝜽​[1‖Xi−Xj‖]=UΓi​j​((Ai−Aj)​𝜽).\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}}}\!\left[\frac{1}{\|X_{i}-\bm{R}_{I}\|}\right]=U_{\Sigma_{ii}}(A_{i}\bm{\theta}-\bm{R}_{I}),\qquad\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi_{\bm{\theta}}}\!\left[\frac{1}{\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|}\right]=U_{\Gamma_{ij}}((A_{i}-A_{j})\bm{\theta}).

Hence

Let

Appendix D Experimental Settings

D.1 Restricted Boltzmann Machine

The restricted Boltzmann machine (RBM) proposed in [6], is used as the wavefunction ansätz for spin-lattice models and takes the form

ψ𝜽​(𝐱)=e∑j=1Naj​xj​∏k=1Dcosh⁡(bk+∑j=1Nwk​j​xj),\psi_{\bm{\theta}}(\mathbf{x})=e^{\sum_{j=1}^{N}a_{j}x_{j}}\prod_{k=1}^{D}\cosh(b_{k}+\sum_{j=1}^{N}w_{kj}x_{j}),

where 𝜽=(aj,bk,wk​j)j=1,…,N;k=1,…,D\bm{\theta}=(a_{j},b_{k},w_{kj})_{j=1,\dots,N;\,k=1,\dots,D}. For spin-lattice systems, the configuration satisfies 𝐱∈{−1,1}N\mathbf{x}\in\{-1,1\}^{N}.

D.2 Electronic Hamiltonian

In electron structure theory, the electronic Hamiltonian takes the form:

ℋ:=−12∑i=1NΔ𝒙i−∑i=1N∑I=1MZI‖𝒙i−𝑹I‖+∑1≤i<j≤N1‖𝒙i−𝒙j‖+∑1≤I<I′≤MZI​ZI′‖𝑹I−𝑹I′‖,\mathscr{H}:=-\frac{1}{2}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\Delta_{\bm{x}_{i}}-\sum_{i=1}^{N}\sum_{I=1}^{M}\frac{Z_{I}}{\left\|\bm{x}_{i}-\bm{R}_{I}\right\|}+\sum_{1\leq i<j\leq N}\frac{1}{\left\|\bm{x}_{i}-\bm{x}_{j}\right\|}+\sum_{1\leq I<I^{\prime}\leq M}\dfrac{Z_{I}Z_{I^{\prime}}}{\left\|\bm{R}_{I}-\bm{R}_{I^{\prime}}\right\|}, (D.1)

where {𝑹I}I=1M⊆ℝ3\{\bm{R}_{I}\}_{I=1}^{M}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{3} are nuclear positions and {ZI}I=1M⊆ℕ\{Z_{I}\}_{I=1}^{M}\subseteq\mathbb{N} are nuclear charges.

D.3 Transverse-Field Ising Model and Heisenberg Model

Both TFI and Heisenberg models consist of chains of Pauli matrices. The Pauli matrices are defined as

σx=(0110),σy=(0−ii0),σz=(100−1).\sigma^{x}=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\ 1&0\end{pmatrix},\quad\sigma^{y}=\begin{pmatrix}0&-i\\ i&0\end{pmatrix},\quad\sigma^{z}=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\ 0&-1\end{pmatrix}.

The Pauli operator acting on site ii is defined as

σiℓ:=I⊗(i−1)⊗σℓ⊗I⊗(N−i)∈ℂ2N×2N,ℓ∈{x,y,z},1≤i≤N,\sigma_{i}^{\ell}:=I^{\otimes(i-1)}\otimes\sigma^{\ell}\otimes I^{\otimes(N-i)}\in\mathbb{C}^{2^{N}\times 2^{N}},\ell\in\{x,y,z\},~1\leq i\leq N,

where ⊗\otimes denotes the Kronecker product. The TFI and Heisenberg Hamiltonians are defined as

  • •

    TFI model: ℋ=−∑<i,j>σizσjz−h∑jσjx\mathscr{H}=-\sum_{<i,j>}\sigma_{i}^{z}\sigma_{j}^{z}-h\sum_{j}\sigma_{j}^{x}, where h>0h>0 is the transverse-field strength.

  • •

    Heisenberg model: ℋ=∑<i,j>σix​σjx+σiy​σjy+σiz​σjz\mathscr{H}=\sum_{<i,j>}\sigma_{i}^{x}\sigma_{j}^{x}+\sigma_{i}^{y}\sigma_{j}^{y}+\sigma_{i}^{z}\sigma_{j}^{z}.

Here <i,j><i,j> denotes a nearest-neighbor pair.
